category_edits.rationale: Weight each training interaction by the inverse square root of its user's training-history length. This may reduce long-history users' influence on the frequency feature across all four datasets. Retain the existing transform, attenuation and checkpoint buffer, so inference remains consistent.

change_summary: Use history-length-weighted training frequencies for all four category models. Preserve the existing normalization, square root, attenuation, architecture and checkpoint-backed predictor.
